name: orchestra
description: Multi-session agent orchestration: a maestro session that only coordinates, workstream sessions that each own a feature from spec to PR, 9 subagents with set models and ponytail modes, handoff notes and isolated test data per workstream. No database, server or Docker required.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives for your account: 60 on a subscription, 5 for API keys and overage. The band keeps it warm just before it ends while a subagent runs.

warmMaxHours.title: Keep-warm limit (hours)
warmMaxHours.description: Stop keeping the cache warm for a subagent that has run this long.
